skill.summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common education questions. Use when working on FAQ content for teachers, tutors, educational institutions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Build Education FAQ Page skill.

- Designed for teachers, tutors, and educational institutions creating FAQ content.
- Provides a structured workflow for drafting, refining, and optimizing FAQ pages.
- Integrates with chat and web search APIs to enhance answers.
